name: manual_cfe54b
claim: Cross-fleet filesystem tests must pass raising=False when mocking os.path.isjunction on Python 3.11 runtimes where the attribute is absent.

decisions.notes: Python 3.11 Windows runtime lacks os.path.isjunction (introduced in 3.12); test_private_store.py required raising=False to avoid AttributeError.
